name: ro-array-core-meta-power
description: Shipped 2-ring x 11-stage array WITH the metastability tap (design/ro_array_core_meta.spice): the same per-ring period, supply current and swing measurements as ro-array-core-power, plus the tap's own supply current on vddm.
tstep: 1p (print step; ngspice's own LTE sets the actual solver step)
analyses: tran 1p 50n
meas tran t1a when v(xdut.xcore.ro1)=v(vth) rise=2
meas tran t1b when v(xdut.xcore.ro1)=v(vth) rise=6
meas tran t2a when v(xdut.xcore.ro2)=v(vth) rise=2
meas tran t2b when v(xdut.xcore.ro2)=v(vth) rise=6
meas tran c1a find v(q1) when v(xdut.xcore.ro1)=v(vth) rise=2
meas tran c1b find v(q1) when v(xdut.xcore.ro1)=v(vth) rise=6
meas tran c2a find v(q2) when v(xdut.xcore.ro2)=v(vth) rise=2
meas tran c2b find v(q2) when v(xdut.xcore.ro2)=v(vth) rise=6
meas tran cta find v(qt) when v(xdut.xcore.ro1)=v(vth) rise=2
meas tran ctb find v(qt) when v(xdut.xcore.ro1)=v(vth) rise=6
meas tran cma find v(qm) when v(xdut.xcore.ro1)=v(vth) rise=2
meas tran cmb find v(qm) when v(xdut.xcore.ro1)=v(vth) rise=6
meas tran vhi max v(xdut.xcore.ro1) from=25n to=48n
meas tran vlo min v(xdut.xcore.ro1) from=25n to=48n
meas tran vxhi max v(xo) from=25n to=48n
meas tran vxlo min v(xo) from=25n to=48n
meas tran vmhi max v(mo) from=25n to=48n
meas tran vmlo min v(mo) from=25n to=48n
let cq = 1e-9
let nper = 4
let nstg = 11
